# Add cyber resilience by detecting user attacks and changing behavior

## Goals for updated system functionality
Increase the cyber resilience of the system by counting the number of rejected mavlink messages and updating the mode of the system when a specified threshold is reached.
method: Whitespace-trimmed, order-aware final-vs-baseline line diff; equal lines moved within a file are excluded. Count added/replacement nonblank noncomment lines once. Deleted lines recorded, unpriced. Newly introduced ModeManager generate-once resources are compared to the historical first-generation scaffold; no pristine generation is claimed.
